method: One frame per second, 0–4199 seconds inclusive. All 4,200 sampled frames visually reviewed in timestamped contact sheets (18 frames per sheet).
finding: The opening 0–53 seconds is a Stream starting soon card. From 54–4199 seconds, the stream shows Mario Kart Tour menus and repeated 8-player multiplayer/VS races in the Shy Guy Cup, including 3DS Daisy Hills R, SNES Rainbow Road T, and London Loop R. Finish screens show placements and points; detailed result screens show Actions Performed and bonus points. No identifiable Time Trial record, lap split, or WR contender time. No record imported.
limitations: One-second sampling does not certify every displayed frame or audio.
The remaining 4200–8292 seconds has been indexed into contact sheets but not yet visually reviewed.
